method_label: W-BFP4 / Top-2-capped A-BiE4 G16 + DEWA + direct exception FP-ACC
quantization: single-exponent W-BFP4 and signed-mu3sigma Top-2-capped A-BiE4 fake quantization
format: Weight BFP4 (1S3M + one E5, G16); Activation BiE4 (1S3M + two E5 + capped type, G16)

dewa_contract.normal_window: configured drop/replace window around the current numeric accumulator

threshold_contract.granularity: one complete nn.Linear input tensor per forward call

top2_contract.block_definition: contiguous Group-16 values along Linear K
top2_contract.encoded_rule: up to two largest-magnitude threshold candidates
top2_contract.demoted_rule: remaining candidates join normal before exponent selection

routing_contract.normal_partial: sum of normal activation products within one G16
routing_contract.exception_partial: sum of zero-to-two encoded outlier products within one G16
routing_contract.exception_destination: every nonzero exception partial goes directly to shared FP32 FP-ACC

exception_policy: all nonzero exception partials directly enter FP32 FP-ACC
